requiredHarnessChecks: Connection URL loopback/55433/approved migration owner and bootstrap database validated before CREATE DATABASE. Never print credentials.
Generated target name starts datacare_context_migration_; verify unique database owner/comment before applying or dropping. Exact SQL BEGIN/COMMIT is not rewritten.
Setup must succeed before the case is credited; migration failure must match the explicit intended rejection message.
Every failure leaves complete table/schema/default/constraint/row/raw+xmin+ctid snapshots exactly unchanged from after setup.

Success leaves all legacy business/auth values unchanged, including nullable year, microsecond times, refresh hash and revoked/expiry state; retains table/PK/index/expiry/policy/RLS/owner/ACL identity.
Success permits intentional context backfill row versions to change; rerunning successful migration must leave complete post-migration physical snapshots unchanged.
Success checksSql must output exactly one true boolean, not merely exit0.
After success, app_user sees only its bound seeded tenant under forced RLS; no role creation or runtime table mutation.
Database cleanup only occurs if generated name/owner/comment still match; preserve failing logs and never drop an unrelated database.
notClaimed: No arbitrary inherited or triggered schema supported
